subject.title: feat(talk): enable GPT Live with Codex OAuth

question: Should OpenClaw make a generic realtime browser-session broker a supported Plugin SDK contract for this Codex OAuth Talk fallback, or keep this experiment out of the current core/plugin API surface?
rationale: The patch exports new broker registration and lookup APIs while adding an auth-sensitive product capability; that public extension direction cannot be selected safely by automated review.

options.title: Sponsor the broker API
options.body: Approve the generic broker contract, then require focused compatibility and real-runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the API internal
options.body: Refactor the experiment so bundled Codex integration does not publish a general Plugin SDK broker contract.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause the PR until maintainers define the supported OAuth-backed realtime product and plugin extension direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the broker API
recommendation.body: Approve the generic broker contract, then require focused compatibility and real-runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main feature ownership could not be established from the supplied provenance without guessing.
